ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a larger circle centered at J and a smaller circle centered at K. A slanted straight line passes through points A, J, B, C, K, and D. Points A and C lie on the larger circle on opposite sides of center J, so AC is a diameter of circle J. Point B is between A and C on the same line. Reasoning: Circle J has radius 10 units, so its diameter AC is 2 × 10 = 20 units. Since B lies between A and C and BC = 5.4 units, AB = AC - BC = 20 - 5.4 = 14.6 units.

Use segment subtraction: AB = AC - BC = 20 - 5.4 = 14.6.
